name: Planning Commission Special Meeting
minutes_text:
MINUTES
  PLANNING COMMISSION SPECIAL MEETING
  MONDAY, AUGUST 31, 2020

  A special meeting of the Planning Commission of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was called to
  order by CHAIR CARMAN at 7:00 p.m. Pursuant to the Governor’s Executive Order N-29-20, this
  meeting was held via teleconference.

  2.  SALUTE TO THE FLAG

  CHAIR CARMAN led those assembled in the Pledge of Allegiance.

  3.  ROLL CALL

  Commissioner’s Present:  Carman, Edler, Medawar, Schachter, Scott, Yoo

  Commissioner’s Absent:  Zigrang

  Staff Member’s Present:  Jeannie Naughton, Planning Manager
  Kelley Thom, Associate Planner
  Carol Corea, Administrative Assistant

  4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  A.  APPROVAL OF PLANNING COMMISSION MINUTES, AUGUST 3, 2020

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER MEDAWAR to,

  APPROVE THE PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES OF AUGUST 3, 2020.

  There being no objection, CHAIR CARMAN so ordered.

  5.  AUDIENCE ITEMS

  NONE

  6.  CONSENT CALENDAR

  A.  Reading in full of all ordinances and resolutions presented for consideration to the Planning
  Commission will be waived and all such ordinances and resolutions will be read by title only.

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER MEDAWAR to,

  APPROVE ITEM 6A

  There being no objection, CHAIR CARMAN so ordered.

  7.  BUSINESS ITEMS

  A.  PLANNING APPLICATION NO. PA-200221; APPLICANT: KRISTI SKELTON, UNBOUND
  ARCHITECTURE; LOCATION: 91 DAPPLEGRAY LANE; A request for approval of a
  Neighborhood Compatibility Determination (NC-200222) for a 200 sq. ft. extension of an
  existing second story deck over a one-story 357 sq. ft. addition.

  Associate Planner Thom provided a presentation summarizing the staff report for Planning
  Application No. PA-200221, a Neighborhood Compatibility Determination for a 200 sq. ft. extension
  of an existing second story deck over a one-story 357 sq. ft. addition.

  Associate Planner Thom stated that correspondence was received by staff late in the day today
  from the neighbor at 87 Dapplegray Lane. The neighbor stated that she did not receive the notice
  that was sent out regarding this project. The neighbor expressed concerns about privacy.

  Associate Planner Thom stated that there is an issue on the plan which does not accurately show
  the proposed deck extension.

  Associate Planner Thom stated that based upon inaccurate information on the plans, staff
  recommends that this item be continued.

  In response to a question by COMMISSIONER SCOTT, Associate Planner Thom stated that the
  deck is proposed to tie-in and extend four feet to tie-in with the front door staircase.

  In response to a question by COMMISSIONER YOO, Associate Planner Thom stated that at the

MINUTES, AUGUST 31, 2020  1
   closest point, there is a two-foot side setback and in some areas, there is a five-foot setback.

  Associate Planner Thom further explained the portion on the plan that is inaccurate. A discussion
  ensued about the distance from the adjacent property.

  Kristi Skelton, Unbound Architecture, stated that the portion of the deck that is shown inaccurately
  was shown this way because that is the way it was originally approved, but will clarify this on the
  plans. Ms. Skelton stated that the homeowner has been working with the neighbor and they had
  no knowledge of her concern.

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT asked if the property owner is willing to have this continued and work
  with the neighbor on her concerns. Ms. Skelton stated that the property owner has no problem with
  this.

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER YOO to,

  CONTINUE PLANNING APPLICATION NO. PA-200221 TO A DATE UNCERTAIN.

  Ayes:  Carman, Edler, Medawar, Schachter, Scott, Yoo
  Noes:
  Absent:  Zigrang
  Abstain:

  B.  PLANNING APPLICATION NO. PA-16-18; APPLICANT: GEORGE SHEN; LOCATION: 4
  SINGLETREE LANE; A request for a six (6) month extension for entitlements approved
  under Planning Application No. PA-16-18 for a Neighborhood Compatibility Determination
  for a new one-story residence. A grading application is required for grading in the rear yard.

  Associate Planner Thom stated that the Planning Commission approved this case in 2018.
  Following the approval, the applicant was working with his architect to refine the architectural
  drawings. Due to the pandemic, there were delays and uncertain economic outlook that affected
  plan preparation.

  Associate Planning Thom stated that staff recommends the approval of a six-month extension for
  entitlements under Planning Application No. PA-16-18.

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER MEDAWAR to,

  APPROVE A REQUEST FOR A SIX-MONTH EXTENSION FOR ENTITLEMENTS
  APPROVED UNDER APPLICATION NO. PA-16-18.

  Ayes:  Carman, Edler, Medawar, Schachter, Scott, Yoo
  Noes:
  Absent:  Zigrang
  Abstain:

  C.  PLANNING APPLICATION NO. PA-200231; LOCATION: 550 DEEP VALLEY DRIVE; A
  request for approval of a Precise Plan of Design (PPD-200229), to amend the Master Sign
  Program for 550 Deep Valley Drive (Promenade on the Peninsula).

  Planning Manager Naughton provided a presentation summarizing Planning Application No. PA-
  2002341, a request to amend the Master Sign Program at the Promenade on the Peninsula. A new
  tenant, Fusion Academy, will be moving into approximately 9,800 sq. ft. space at the second level.
  The Promenade is proposing to add an additional exterior sign along Drybank Drive. The new sign,
  which is 37 sq. ft., is proposed to be internally illuminated.

  Staff is proposing to make changes to the request by proposing that the sign not be internally
  illuminated; that the proposed raceway be removed; that the individual channel letters be affixed
  to the building; and, rather than the polycarbonate nylon face that it be a powder coated aluminum
  painted with a matte finish. If illumination is necessary, reverse halo illumination may be permitted.

  Staff recommends that the Planning Commission approve Planning Application PA200231, to
  amend the Master Sign Program for 550 Deep Valley Drive (Promenade on the Peninsula) subject
  to the following conditions as stated in the staff report.

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT asked about the difference in cost from what they are proposing and
  backlighting. COMMISSIONER MEDAWAR stated that the cost is approximately 25-30% more and
  added that he is in agreement with staff.

  Cortney Medak, General Manager, stated that the tenant has no issue with the conditions.

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT made motion, seconded by VICE CHAIR EDLER to,

PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
MINUTES, AUGUST 31, 2020  2
   APPROVE PLANNING APPLICATION PA200231, TO AMEND THE MASTER SIGN
  PROGRAM FOR 550 DEEP VALLEY DRIVE (PROMENADE ON THE PENINSULA)
  SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING CONDITIONS AS STATED IN THE STAFF REPORT.

  Ayes:  Carman, Edler, Medawar, Schachter, Scott, Yoo
  Noes:
  Absent:  Zigrang
  Abstain:

  8.  PUBLIC HEARINGS

  NONE

  9.  COMMISSION ITEMS

  NONE

  10.  PLANNING MANAGER ITEMS

  Planning Manager Naughton stated that Merrill Gardens has received finals on their permits and
  should have their Certificate of Occupancy later this week.

  Planning Manager Naughton stated that the Planning Association Conference is going to take place
  virtually from September 14 – 16, 2020 and extended the invitation to Planning Commissioners who
  are interested in attending.

  In response to a question by COMMISSIONER MEDAWAR, Planning Manager Naughton stated
  that regarding reopening, Los Angeles County is not at the point to reopen at this time. The Governor
  issued a four-tier reopening protocol for counties and each will depend on the COVID-19 numbers
  in each county.

  11.  MATTERS OF INFORMATION

  A.  CITY COUNCIL ACTION ITEMS, JULY 28, 2020

  B.  CITY COUNCIL ACTION ITEMS, AUGUST 25, 2020

  C.  PARK AND ACTIVITIES MEETING DRAFT MINUTES, AUGUST 17, 2020

  COMMITTEE MEMBER SCOTT made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER YOO to,

  APPROVE ITEMS 11-A THROUGH 11-C

  There being no objection, CHAIR CARMAN so ordered.

  10.  ADJOURNMENT

  CHAIR CARMAN adjourned the meeting at 7:45 pm. The next Planning Commission meeting will
  be held on Monday, October 5, 2020 at 7:00 pm via Video Teleconference.

  Respectfully submitted,  Approved,

  Carol Corea, Administrative Assistant  Bridget Carman, Chair
